name: one-erp
description: 一套面向制造与供应链场景的 AI Native ERP，主打元数据驱动、事件驱动和多端协同
author: OneERP Team

scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/api run lint && npm --prefix apps/web run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/api run test -- --passWithNoTests && npm --prefix apps/web run test
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.validate: npm --prefix apps/api run prisma:validate && npm --prefix apps/api run prisma:generate && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
